decisions.reason: As the flagship organic platter line close to core curing competencies, it remains central to the strategic direction and shows no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The organic boiled sausage was launched only in 2024 and is actively promoted, so it fits the organic expansion and slack from a growing market lets the firm carry it while results are still uncertain.

The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line is new and prominently presented, and although poultry is a step from the core, there is no evidence of a shortfall yet, so the firm will keep it through its first full year.

The herb-coated organic salami sits close to core competencies and supports the organic focus, but it overlaps with other salami formats in an assortment the firm has already pruned, so it carries somewhat higher risk while remaining within aspiration.
